name: Ningaloo Whaleshark Swim
summary: Ningaloo Whaleshark Swim runs full day whale shark swims out of Exmouth, a humpback whale swim tour from August, and a lower priced ecotour from mid September. Guests are picked up from Exmouth accommodation and taken by bus to Tantabiddi boat ramp to board the vessel Seazone. The company flies its own spotter plane to help find the animals.
standouts: Owns and flies its own spotter plane, a Cessna 182, for its tours
EcoStar and Sustainable Tourism accreditations through the Australian Tourism Industry Council
Passenger to crew ratio stated as less than 3 to 1
Tour vessel Seazone is a 19 metre Conquest boat

trips.title: Whale Shark Swim Wonder Tour
trips.summary: A full day boat trip from Exmouth to swim with whale sharks on the Ningaloo Reef. Guests are collected from their accommodation by bus, board the vessel Seazone at Tantabiddi boat ramp, and snorkel the reef before and after the search for a whale shark. The company flies its own spotter plane, and each swim group has an in-water guide.
highlights: Own spotter plane flown for the company's tours
Free pickup and drop off from Exmouth accommodation
Two reef snorkels, with morning tea, lunch and afternoon tea
Optional scuba dive in the lagoon after the swim: certified fun dive, Try SCUBA or refresher

trips.requirements: Swimmers must be able to swim independently in the open ocean. Children 6 to 16 book as child swimmers; children under 6 are usually not permitted to swim unless a parent can vouch they are confident in the open ocean. Children under 12 must be directly supervised by a parent or guardian at all times. The licence allows 20 swimmers a day. Every guest signs a waiver to enter the water. The vessel and bus are not wheelchair accessible (a small boat transfers guests to the vessel), so contact the company before booking. Scuba add-on: certified divers need proof of certification and a dive in the last 12 months.

Season end date differs between pages: mid October, mid to late October, October 31, while the price page's shoulder season ends October 15. Times: bus pickups start 7:00am, the vessel leaves Tantabiddi about 8:30am, the itinerary has the boat back at Tantabiddi at 2:30pm and guests in town from 3 to 5pm, and the price page says around 4.30pm; the site says times vary and the tour is not 10 hours long, so no duration in minutes is given. The humpback page names two booking products ('Whale shark Swim + Wonder Tour | March - July' and 'Whale shark (then Whale!) Wonder Tour | August - September'), so the widget may hold more than one product for this trip; not opened. trips.title: Humpback Whale Wonder Tour
trips.summary: A full day boat trip from Exmouth to attempt an in-water swim with humpback whales, run from August 1 each year. The spotter plane stays up for the whole tour, and the pilot and skipper check each pod before a group is put in the water. Swimmers need to be confident open-ocean snorkellers, and whale watcher tickets let others watch from the deck and join the reef snorkels.
highlights: Own spotter plane in the air for the whole tour
Pods are checked for undersized calves before any swim, and the whales choose whether to interact
Swimmers swim to the whales from the boat, often 200 metres or more
Whale watcher tickets for guests who stay on deck, with reef snorkels included

trips.title: Ningaloo Ecotour
trips.summary: A lower priced full day boat trip from mid September to October 31, with reef snorkels and the chance to swim with a whale shark, humpback whale or manta ray. A swim with a whale shark or humpback whale is added for $50, and is charged only if you actually get in the water with one.
highlights: Runs mid September to October 31 only
Whale shark or humpback whale swim added for $50, only charged if you swim
Multiple snorkels on the Ningaloo Reef
Free pickup and drop off from select accommodation

checkNotes: Name: the live site uses 'Ningaloo Whaleshark Swim' (page titles also use 'Whale Sharks Exmouth'); our list has '(Ningaloo Whalesharks)'. The site does not redirect to another business's domain. Booking: one Rezdy catalog widget is embedded on the book-online page (iframe from ningaloowhalesharks.rezdy.com, catalog 23602), reached from every tour page's 'Book Online Now' button with section anchors #whale-shark-tours, #humpback-whale and #ecotours, so each trip lists that page as its booking link; rezdy.com was not opened, so widget prices, times and products were not checked. A second widget for gift vouchers is on the gift-vouchers book-online page (catalog 513734). Left out as not trips the company runs and describes: the Navy Pier, Muiron Islands and Lighthouse Bay dive trips (the pages say the company helps organise them with another provider; the Navy Pier page notes a Defence surcharge of $50 per person); 'Hire the Whole Boat' (the home page link /hire-the-boat returns a 404, so there are no details or prices); the scuba dive extras on the whale shark tour (certified fun dive, Try SCUBA, refresher), which are add-ons without prices on the site and are mentioned in the whale shark trip. 'Whale Watching Tours' on the home page redirects to the humpback suitability page, so whale watching is covered as a price option on the humpback tour. Contact: phone is the mobile shown across the site. The email info@ningaloowhalesharks.com was read from the contact page, where the site hides it with Cloudflare email protection; the essential information pages also give info@experiencewonder.com.au for urgent after-hours enquiries, and the dive page shows a second phone number (9949 4777). The office at Shop 4, 1 Kennedy Street is open seven days a week from 9am to 5:30pm. Prices on every page show a $ sign with no currency code, so AUD is assumed. Terms and conditions and the cancellation policy were not read. The site makes sighting claims and guarantees (sighting rates, a 13 year study, no sighting refund, good swim and seasickness guarantees); none are repeated as fact in the page copy. Fetching: the site answered with an occasional 520 error on a first request that worked on retry; no captcha or bot check was met. About 40 pages read, so some minor pages (Our Bus, Our Shop, trip planner, awards, safety pages, testimonials) were not.
